title: RibonanzaNet-SS — RNA base-pairing probability matrix
description: Run RibonanzaNet-SS on a single RNA sequence and return its L×L base-pairing probability matrix (0..1) — the model's native contact-head output, parallel to structRFM's attention map. Off-diagonal probability hints at base pairs, including crossing/pseudoknot interactions. It is a model prediction, not an experimentally validated structure, and no pairing cutoff is calibrated.
citation: He et al., RibonanzaNet (Ribonanza, Das lab). Code: https://github.com/Shujun-He/RibonanzaNet (MIT); SS head: kaggle.com/code/shujun717/ribonanzanet-2d-structure-inference

fields.name: sequence
fields.label: RNA sequence
fields.help: A single RNA sequence over A/C/G/U only (no N — the model has no unknown-base token).

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.help: Prediction is deterministic; seed is accepted for reproducibility bookkeeping.

example_summary: A tiny 12-nucleotide RNA hairpin (GGGGAAAACCCC), bundled so you can try the pipeline without supplying a sequence.
example_details: A hand-picked minimal hairpin (GGGGAAAACCCC): four G-C pairs closing a four-base loop. It exercises the sequence -> base-pairing-matrix path end to end. Swap in any single RNA sequence over A/C/G/U (no N). Real inference returns RibonanzaNet-SS's L×L base-pairing probability matrix; the fake backend returns a deterministic placeholder matrix (engine=stub).
notes: Output kind is `contact_map` (L×L base-pairing probability matrix, matrix_type=base_pairing), reusing the existing wired kind — parallel to structRFM's attention map. We expose the model's native contact-head sigmoid output and deliberately SKIP the dot-bracket conversion (which would need arnie.pk_predictors._hungarian + scipy); the raw probability matrix is simpler, dependency-light, and more faithful. ACGU-only input (the tokenizer KeyErrors on N), enforced by a per-method validator. The canonical SS head is a Kaggle notebook; the fetchable self-contained implementation (code + config.yaml + checkpoint ribonanzanet_ss.pt, ~45 MB) is the gRNAde copy (tools/ribonanzanet_sec_struct/, chaitjo/gRNAde on HF), which credits Shujun-He/RibonanzaNet. source_commit (gRNAde clone), checkpoint_digest, worker_image_digest and max_length stay provisional until a Runpod smoke run. The runner reports engine=ribonanzanet vs engine=stub; use_grad_checkpoint is patched off at inference. No MSA, no folding binaries, no arnie, no torch_geometric.
